uncertain: Dashed corridors preserve the documented room sequence but do not establish exact bends, lengths, orientation or elevation. Solid room outlines are schematic abstractions, not surveyed footprints.
The exact locations of Doomrigger's Coffer and the Darkstone Tablet within the Rookery are unverified; Q1 and Q2 are area markers.
Jed Runewatcher patrols; marker 3 is an approximate search location. The relative placement of the forge and the hall is schematic.
The precise chest position for The Demon Forge, Awbee on the exit route, and the Orb of Ascension behind General Drakkisath are unverified; Q3-Q5 are area markers.
The post-arena bridge elevations and detailed connection to the Beast side branch are unverified. No shortcut or direct return from the arena floor to its entry balcony is asserted.
